# GPUWidgets/View

## Headers

- [CoverageShader.h](CoverageShader.h): The consumer half of PathRasterizer: a quad, placed in device pixels, that paints a solid colour through a coverage mask. (declares `CoverageShader`)
- [PathFillShader.h](PathFillShader.h): The EDSL-authored shader for solid fills and strokes. (declares `PathFillShader`)
- [PathView.h](PathView.h): A GPU-rendered view that fills and/or strokes a Path. (declares `PathView`)
- [VertexColorShader.h](VertexColorShader.h): Fills a 2D triangle mesh with per-vertex colour, interpolated across each triangle. (declares `VertexColorShader`)
- [Vertices.h](Vertices.h): Position-only vertex, used for solid fills and strokes. (declares `FillVertex`, `GradientVertex`)
